prompt: I've been working as a technical writer at a SaaS company for 3 years, and I have three documents: my current resume (a bit outdated), a PDF of my latest Betterworks performance review from my manager, and an old CV from 2021. I need to create a modern, ATS-friendly resume that showcases my API documentation work and my GitHub portfolio. Can you generate both a Markdown and HTML version that I can host on GitHub?

assertions.name: resume-markdown-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a resume.md file in proper Markdown format

assertions.name: resume-html-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a resume.html file with valid HTML structure

assertions.name: quantified-achievements
assertions.description: Resume contains at least 4 quantified achievements (with %, numbers, or metrics) from Betterworks review

assertions.name: api-documentation-emphasis
assertions.description: API documentation expertise is prominently featured in summary or top achievements

assertions.name: ats-compliance
assertions.description: Markdown resume uses single-column layout, no tables, standard structure for ATS parsing

assertions.name: portfolio-section
assertions.description: HTML includes a portfolio/GitHub links section with placeholders

assertions.name: high-value-keywords
assertions.description: Resume includes at least 8 high-value keywords (Git, Markdown, Docusaurus, OpenAPI, CI/CD, etc.)

assertions.name: synthesis-quality
assertions.description: Resume coherently integrates content from all three input sources (current resume, review, old CV)
